purpose: Governed source identities for U.S. Employment Situation first-print actuals and point-in-time market consensus. This contract authorizes source audit/reconstruction only; it does not authorize model scoring or forecast/decision writes.
point_in_time_rule: For any event at t, a model input is eligible only when its provider semantics prove that it was a pre-release consensus associated with that event. Current-vintage substitution for historical first-print actuals or post-release consensus is forbidden.

consensus_provider_policy.preferred_authority_benchmark: Bloomberg Economic Calendar historical latest pre-release panel consensus, when entitlement is available
consensus_provider_policy.secondary_candidate: Econoday, only after separate historical PIT/entitlement audit
forbidden_substitutes: current Trading Economics website calendar without governed PIT retrieval
post-release news consensus reconstructed after the fact
per-origin provider switching after viewing model results
consensus_provider_policy.te_forecast_semantic: Forecast = survey consensus from representative group of economists
consensus_provider_policy.te_teforecast_semantic: TEForecast = Trading Economics proprietary/model projection; never market consensus
consensus_provider_policy.te_availability_semantics: When TE PIT preserves the pre-release Forecast field but does not expose the exact last pre-release consensus update timestamp, the consensus may be eligible only at the official release timestamp and must be tagged PRE_RELEASE_CONSENSUS_FIELD_PRESERVED_BY_PROVIDER_AT_EVENT_RELEASE. It may not be used for a decision timestamp strictly before release.
consensus_provider_policy.te_lastupdate_policy: LastUpdate is record-update metadata and must not be treated as the consensus availability timestamp.
consensus_provider_policy.raw_payload_policy: Do not commit licensed raw provider payloads to the public repository; retain hashes/identifiers and only license-permitted evidence.

MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published total nonfarm payroll employment monthly change
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive / ALFRED as-of release reconstruction after equivalence audit
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: release-date first print; later revisions must not overwrite the archived first print

MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published unemployment rate
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive / ALFRED as-of release reconstruction after equivalence audit
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: release-date first print; later revisions must not overwrite the archived first print

MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published average hourly earnings month-over-month change for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive / ALFRED as-of release reconstruction after equivalence audit
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: derive transparently from as-of-release AHE levels when needed; construction equivalence must be audited against BLS first releases

MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Provider-preserved pre-release market consensus for headline NFP change associated with the Employment Situation release
MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: eligible no earlier than official release timestamp after provider audit; exact pre-release update time must not be invented
